purpose: Conservative sink inventory for human review; findings are not automatically exploitable vulnerabilities.
coverage: JavaScript/TypeScript dynamic code and HTML sinks
C# process launches, XML resolver enabling, archive extraction and SQL construction
limitations: Does not prove SQL parameterization, URL/feed destination safety, authorization or browser origin defenses
Does not exhaust framework aliases, reflection or all process/archive APIs
Generic path containment and resource limits require manual review and adversarial regression tests
Rules and parser errors must be retained; static trusted uses need finding-specific independent review
review: Rules intentionally inventory both safe and unsafe sinks. No source files or rule findings are silently allowlisted.
